name: NeMo RL
summary: NVIDIA Apache-2.0 post-training / reinforcement-learning library for large-scale model training, with official docs and NGC containers.
description: Established NVIDIA project (canonical repo NVIDIA-NeMo/RL; not archived; created 2025-03-16; not a 2026 launch). Older GitHub paths NVIDIA/NeMo-RL and NVIDIA/nemo-rl redirect to NVIDIA-NeMo/RL. Root LICENSE is Apache-2.0. GitHub latest release v0.8.0 was published 2026-11-06T22:22:08Z. PyPI package nemo-rl is 0.0.0 (uploaded 2025-06-03, homepage still lists github.com/NVIDIA/NeMo-RL) and is not treated as the current install path. Official README quick start uses the NGC container nvcr.io/nvidia/nemo-rl:latest plus a git clone of NVIDIA-NeMo/RL, or a bare-metal setup described in the installation guide. Docs: https://docs.nvidia.com/nemo/rl/latest/index.html and the installation guide at https://docs.nvidia.com/nemo/rl/latest/about/installation.html (both HTTP 200). Training uses GPUs and may pull gated model weights; those costs and any cloud or NGC access are separate. This library can run training jobs that execute model and environment code — follow upstream safety guidance. Vendor: NVIDIA.

agent_access.notes: Open-source library. Documented install is the NGC container and/or git clone of NVIDIA-NeMo/RL, not the stale PyPI 0.0.0 package. GPU and optionally Hugging Face tokens for gated models are required by upstream examples; none were used here.
